source.title: On two open problems about embedding of modules in free modules

accepted.question_text: For a ring R, call R a left FGF ring when each finitely generated module over R on the left side can be injected into some free left R-module. Must every left FGF ring be Quasi-Frobenius?

evidence.quote: Is a left FGF ring Quasi-Frobenius?

accepted.question_text: For a ring R, call R a left CF ring when each cyclic module over R on the left side can be injected into some free left R-module. Must every left CF ring be left artinian?

evidence.quote: Is a left CF ring left artinian?
